dark.workload: 8 real builtin Codex agents executing a fixture command; 5s heartbeat and private progress receipts
dark.limitations: Only completed >50ms handlers are profiled. Full summary windows strictly inside the measurement interval form top10; warmup and boundary rows are retained separately. An absent summary is not proof of zero stalls or of collector operation. This heartbeat workload writes private progress receipts and does not cover implementation builds.
